description: In crate-jmap-server/src/helpers.rs, the test now_utc_string_subsecond_uniqueness builds a HashSet of 10 calls and describes intent to assert at least 2 are distinct, but the final statement is 'let _ = seen;' which discards the set without asserting. The test comment says 'we call 10 times and assert at least 2 are distinct' but no assertion is made. A new contributor reading this test believes it verifies sub-second uniqueness; in fact it verifies nothing. The comment at the end explains the probabilistic nature but a passing test that asserts nothing is misleading. Fix: either convert to a real assertion ('assert\!(seen.len() > 1, ...)') or remove the test and keep only the format test.
title: helpers.rs: now_utc_string_subsecond_uniqueness test asserts nothing
